notes.title: v0.4.4 - Fixs and improvements
notes.content:
I've finished my bachelor so I'm full time on the game and 2 artists too, so next update will take more time to choose a DA and refactor a lot the project to be able to develop it faster !

[h1]Added[/h1]

[list]
  [*]2 new room musics
  [*]Display in save selection the total relics level discovered
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[list]
  [*]Change weapon chance per fortress, now scale with sub level too
  [*]Improve how fairies from [b]Elf Bow[/b] weapon move and distance from player
  [*]Improve and fix trajectory of [b]Shadow Scythe[/b] weapon
  [*][b]Soul Reaper[/b] class gain his start soul sword instantly when he have 0 soul swords, removing the soul given by his ability
  [*]Now [b]Echo[/b] relic trigger an echo at the end of a projectile/ray
  [*]Improve various credits-like messages
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[list]
  [*]Reduce knockback from magic aoe from [b]Dragon Scepter[/b] weapon
  [*]Increase [b]Cross Bow[/b] weapon damage from 80-130 to 120-175 and +5% critical chance
  [*]Increase [b]Elf Bow[/b] weapon attack per seconds from 1.3 to 1.8
  [*]Increase [b]Dagger[/b] weapon damage from 10-20 to 20-30
  [*]Increase [b]Bouncing Ball[/b] weapon damage from 40-50 to 55-70
  [*]Increase [b]Magic Bow[/b] weapon damage from 10-20 to 20-30
  [*]Increase [b]Prismatic Light Tome[/b] weapon damage from 50-70 to 85-115 and projectile life time from 1s to 1.5s
  [*]Increase [b]Shuriken[/b] weapon damage from 5-15 to 15-25, reduce speed from 22 to 18, add a 10% chance to inflict bleed and reduce attack per seconds from 5 to 2.5
  [*]Increase [b]Soul Exploiter[/b] weapon damage from 60-90 to 90-125
  [*]Increase [b]Spiky Staff[/b] weapon damage from 75-90 to 85-100
  [*]Increase [b]Star Gun[/b] weapon damage from 20-30 to 45-65 and reduce attack per seconds from 4 to 2.5
  [*]Increase [b]Sword[/b] weapon attack per seconds from 2.25 to 2.5
  [*]Increase [b]Volcano Staff[/b] weapon damage from 80-100 to 100-130
  [*]Increase [b]Shadow Scythe[/b] weapon damage from 50-65 to 70-90
  [*]Randomize the range of **Compression**, **Splitter** and **Unstable Projectile** relics from 30% to 15-30%
  [*]Increase [b]Echo[/b] relic damage from 20% to 30/40/55%, added 0/5/15 flat damage to it, add a trigger by meter travelled so it goes from every 0.4/0.3/0.15s to 0.4/0.4/0.3s or 5/5/4m travelled
  [*]Decrease [b]Aerodynamics[/b] relic bonus damage related to projectile speed from 100/115/140% to 65/85/120%, but include flat projectile speed in it now
  [*]Fix and increase base level of weapons found from 3 to 7 per fortress done and a supp 5 multiplied by the reward factor
  [*]Change **Lightning Rod** relic to be trigger by thunder that hit anything in a 5m radius around the player and make **Thunder Charge** effect use 1 stack to trigger the **Spark**
  [*]Reduce difficulty of some moves of the final boss
  [*]Increase [b]Shell Scepter[/b] weapon attack per seconds from 2 to 2.3
  [*]Increase [b]Zeus Thunder[/b] weapon damage from 25-40 to 35-55, attack per seconds from 1 to 1.7 and change stats increase type by level from thunder refire chance to projectile number
[/list]

[h1]Fixs[/h1]

[list]
  [*]Time achievement was trigger by finishing the same minute while it should be under that minute
  [*]Weapons with animations were using current animation image instead of original one
  [*]Sometimes when the player select the [b]Soul Reaper[/b] class, his souls swords didn't appeared
  [*]When the player press escape key rapidly 2 times, it left a dark background
  [*]The player was able to still reroll items in shops even with no items
  [*]In really rare case, the player weapon was taking a strange scale (since it's rare, maybe this isn't fixed but normally yes)
  [*]Changing him relics was making the game crash because of a loop
  [*]Weapons count and time played displayed in save selection were using wrong datas
  [*]The game had the wrong version number
[/list]

notes.title: v0.4.4 - Steam Achievements and new textures
notes.content:
[h1]Major[/h1]

[h2]Nerfs[/h2]

I have nerf a lot of things, because when the characters are level 1 in their passives, I feel like the game is perfect. But at level 5, this is way too op.
Also, near the end of a game, you are op, that's the goal, but you're [b]too much[/b] op. So I'm trying to reduce a bit this. I hope the game will not become too frustrating.

[h2]New enemies skin[/h2]

All enemies, allies and dummies have an animated sprite now ! And thanks to Plazukie and Lioad, the game artist working on the game, it's beautiful :heart:

[list]
  [*]Idle and attack animations
  [*]Hit animations for dummies
  [*]A lot of new textures for everything
[/list]

[h2]Steam[/h2]

I've added 57 achievements for the demo and the support for cloud saves.

[h1]Added[/h1]

[list]
  [*]3 new boss relics
  [*]1 new colorless relic
  [*]1 new epic weapon
  [*]Added red arrows to spot enemies out of screen
  [*]Added `Unstuck` button in case you're blocked
  [*]Added info button on Him class to explain how it works
  [*]Added a new settings that limit max speed of the player to 15m/s (a room is less than 15m large) equivalent to +200% speed, by default enabled
  [*]Added Blindness room modifier, increase rewards by 1 and reduce a lot the global light
  [*]Zeus Thunder weapon has been revamp, now it just spawn thunder around the mouse, it works with level 3 yellow and green effects
[/list]

[h1]Quality of life[/h1]

[list]
  [*]Display rarity level on relics and weapons
  [*]Make a water shader for the one in the hub
  [*]Make a tree leaves shader for the ones in the hub and tutorial
[/list]

[h1]Improvements[/h1]

[list]
  [*]Add shadow to trees and improve them a bit
  [*]Improve a bit the color aura
  [*]Clarify attack speed minimum gain from Electrified boss relic
  [*]Improve the rarity level of weapons sold by weapon merchant but increase their price
  [*]When a boss die, all enemies are slain at the same time
  [*]Use the mouse direction for the passive Waver of the Samuraï instead of the shoot direction
  [*]Change save selection visual to display color shards, weapons discovered and play time
  [*]Freeze DPS when there are no more more damage done (like in Terraria)
  [*]Improve visually the trails of projectiles and some can have custom colors now
  [*]Changed completly effect of Odin Helmet relic to shoot a spark when hitting with a thunder aoe
  [*]Changed the effect of weapon upgraders to improve better the weapon with the same rarity as the upgrader
[/list]

[h1]Balancing[/h1]

[list]
  [*]Balance all passives (level 2 to 5) and reduce the cost of the upgrades, most of the time, boost the first level and nerf the later ones
  [*]Balance all relics, buff for some the level 1 and nerf a bit the 2 and 3
  [*]Balance all weapons, mostly reduced their damage/buffs
  [*]Nerf yellow altar tier 3 that launch thunder towards 1-3 enemies -> just 1 enemy now
  [*]Nerf attack speed stats gained with the rune and altar tier 1
  [*]Refactor Holy Aura
  [*]Remove Magic Thief relic from boss rarity and move it to rare instead, decreasing his base effects
  [*]Remove Dopamine relic from boss rarity and move it to epic instead
  [*]When picking up Holy Mantle, Firestorm and Free Reroll relics, gains the effect/collectible instantly
  [*]The sacrificial altar now ignore invulnerable effect from the player, but block effect and dodge can still be used to prevent damage
  [*]Reduce difficulty of Thunder Incarnation boss
[/list]

[h1]Fixs[/h1]

[list]
  [*]Major: bonus gold were not given to the player and the gold gain used was wrong
  [*]Major: weapons with more than 3 same colors in it didn't receive the level 3 effect of it
  [*]Falling projectiles with bounce were bouncing infinitely
  [*]A lot of fixs with the tutorial
  [*]Thunder Spirit enemy pattern fix
  [*]Show altar upgrade arrow only if you have enough shards to buy an upgrade
  [*]Fixed a priority bug where block effect trigger before the immunity to thunder of the thundering heart
[/list]

notes.title: v0.4.3 - Tutorial, Endless mode and fixs
notes.content:
A "small" update with a decent tutorial that explain the mecanics and the lore, since next update will take a lot of time due to my bachelor thesis, it's better for new players.

[h2]Endless mode[/h2]

When you finish last boss, you can continue to play with harder enemies each loops with some modifications:

[list]
  [*]No color shards [i]but will change later[/i]
  [*]Weapon rarity increase by 1 fortress per loops (rarity is based on the next fortress)
  [*]Enemies health is increased exponentially by the number of loops
  [*]Enemies armor is increased by the number of loops
[/list]

[h2]Final boss[/h2]

The Monarch, the final boss has been added but he's not final for the game itself since he will have different versions based on each colors, but it's better than having the same 2 yellow bosses looping.

[h2]Added[/h2]

[list]
  [*]A lot of new musics
  [*]Drop button in inventory to drop an item
  [*]New epic relic [b]Pain[/b] -> gain 1/1.5/2.5% critical chance every hit taken
  [*]New rare relic [b]Metronome[/b] -> Projectile range fluctuate between -25/20/10% and 25/35/50%
  [*]New pattern for [b]Thunder Incarnation[/b] boss
  [*]Add particle effects for projectile and ray that apply an effect
  [*]A start message
  [*]Enemy armor is now displayed
  [*]Rewards multiplier is now displayed on doors
[/list]

[h2]Fixs/Improvements[/h2]

[list]
  [*]Glue relics was not working
  [*]Aoe master translations are better
  [*]Aoe range was not updated with aoe
  [*]Improve how homing works, it will always try to get a new target
  [*]Improve feedbacks
  [*]Weapons encounter will not be the same as the player has now
  [*]Fix Thorny and Thunder hearts when getting a damage
  [*]Improved how homing works
  [*]Improve altar menu look
  [*]Change the design of the gold coin
  [*]Armor stats of enemies were not increased correctly for each fortresses
  [*]Complete revamp of weapon displayer to gain space and clarity
  [*]Projectiles that turn around player (or other elements) will now have equal angle offset from each one
  [*]Fix [b]Splitter[/b] relic range activation
  [*][b]Rubber[/b] relic was giving an additional bounce
  [*]Globally improve a lot enemy patterns
  [*]In some rare cases, samuraï ability was not working
  [*]Complete change of [b]Thunder Knight[/b] ally patterns and increase his max health as well as armor
  [*][b]Public Enemy[/b] relic was not working when an enemy was falling
  [*]Falling projectile were bouncing infinitely
  [*][b]Compression[/b] relic now supports rays
  [*]Musics was stopped for unknown reason sometimes
  [*]Prevent duplicators from duplicate themselves
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]

[list]
  [*]Cap max health ratio used by Absolute Control, multiplier are applied after (if you send an enemy to another going in the opposite direction, damage are increased)
  [*]Increase damage from [b]Sword[/b] weapon from 35-45 to 45-55
  [*]Nerf [b]Golden Shotgun[/b] weapon from 1.5 APS to 1 APS, reduce his range and his APS is now increase with gold
  [*]Increase angular speed from [b]Mind Eye[/b] relic from 3/5/10° to 5/10/20°
  [*]Increase base angular speed for players from 5° to 15°
  [*]Nerf [b]Discharge Load[/b] relic by adding a chance to trigger it by 5/10/20%
  [*]Change rarity of [b]Firestorm[/b] relic from legendary to epic
  [*]Change rarity of [b]Compression[/b] relic from epic to legendary
  [*]Reduce projectile lifetime by 70% for [b]Compression, Splitter and Unstable Projectile[/b] relics
  [*]On [b]Holy Cross[/b] weapon, reduce chance to apply holy from 30% to 10% and reduce his range by 30%
  [*]On [b]Bubble Shot[/b] relic, reduce max bubble per second from 10 to 3
  [*]Nerf [b]Rubber[/b] relic by changing his rarity from epic to legendary and having only one level
  [*]Nerf [b]Fire Head[/b] relic by reducing the number of explosive skulls from 3/5/9 to 3/4/6
  [*]Nerf [b]Critical Life[/b] relic by reducing critical chance from 2/4/8% to 1/2/4%
  [*]Nerf [b]Toxic[/b] relic by reducing chance to apply from 30/50/80% to 10/15/20% and effects applied from 1/2/3 to 1/1/2
  [*]Minimum damage inflicted to an enemy is 3 instead of 1
  [*]Projectile of [b]Pink Blossom Katana[/b] now doesn't pass through walls and is way bigger
  [*]Enemies have more logical armor assignement
  [*]Now only soul swords created by [b]Soul Forger[/b] passive will ignore armor instead of all
  [*]Ice spikes created by [b]Glacial Waves[/b] passive ignore armor
  [*]Nerf [b]Critical Curse[/b] relic, reducing critical chance from 5/15/30% to 5/10/20%
  [*]Add a cooldown for stars spawned from [b]Star Dance[/b] passive of 0.3s
  [*]Prevent [b]Absolute Control[/b] ability to do critical damages
[/list]

Also, I've made a separate page for the demo, so it means that now you can post review on it !

notes.title: v0.4.2 - Tag system, Relics & Weapons
notes.content:
The update rate will slow down a lot until july 2025 because I'm starting my bachelor (which will be a game like Noita, combining spells to create exclusive behaviors).
Next update, I will test to add a new power that will make the game more unique and strategic for each colors.

[h1]v0.4.2 - Tag system, Relics & Weapons[/h1]

[h2]Major changes[/h2]

[list]
  [*]Add the tag system, that makes some relics only available if the player has something usable with. Eg: the player need to do aoe for a relic that boost aoe to appear
  [*]Enlarge the corridor to the backroom and bring closer the things in these rooms
  [*]Change the hub, more space and a river
[/list]

[h3]Added 45 New Relics[/h3]

[list]
  [*]6 commons
  [*]14 rares
  [*]11 epics
  [*]6 legendaries
  [*]8 boss
[/list]

[h3]Added 5 New Weapons[/h3]

[list]
  [*]1 rare
  [*]2 epics
  [*]2 exclusives
[/list]

[h3]Piercing and Bouncing shots refactor[/h3]

Now piercing and bouncing are not longer illimited, weapons and relics have changed according to this change

[h3]Homing change[/h3]

Now homing will seek a new target within a range and will not target the same one so it can pass from each ones easily

[h2]Stats[/h2]

[list]
  [*]Added dodge chance and summon dodge chance: have a chance to dodge a hit, cooldown of 3s
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]

[list]
  [*]Nerf [b]Star Dance[/b] relic, speed bonus is decreased from 0.5% to 0.3% and star damage from 2% to 1% per star fragments
  [*]Increase chance to get legendary relics from 3% to 4% and decrease rare relics from 30% to 29%
  [*]Decrease APS of [b]Volcano Scepter[/b] weapon from 0.8 to 0.5
  [*]Thunder mage elite was supposed to have a passive, it's now correctly applied
  [*]Mini refactor of [b]Soul Forger[/b] relic: 16 -> 5 max soul swords but increase by 1 for every elite killed and 2 for boss with no limit
  [*]Decrease max lifetime of [b]Prismatic Light Tome[/b] weapon from 2s to 1s
  [*]Reduce bonus from [b]Chakram Scepter[/b] weapon from 200% to 100%
  [*]Reduce max damage from [b]Dragonic Scepter[/b] weapon from 300 to 230 and aoe from it divided by 2
  [*]Nerf [b]Energy Attacker[/b] relic, reducing attacks from 2/2/3/3/4-5/7/9/11/13 to 1/1/2/2/3-3/5/7/9/11
  [*]Nerf [b]Snowball Effect[/b] relic, reducing bonus from 200/225/250/275/350% to 100/120/140/160/200%
  [*]Nerf [b]Blizzard[/b] ability, reduce number of shoots, damage and chance to apply frost burn
  [*]Nerf [b]Thunder Dash[/b] boss relic, instead of thundering 3 enemies, thunder 1 to 3 enemies
  [*][b]Shell Scepter[/b] weapon now gain angular speed each levels and really have homing
  [*]Remove chance to spawn stars from aoe in [b]Star Dance[/b] relic of the Astromancer
  [*]Reduce star damage per fortress from 15 to 10 for **Starry Trail** relic and from 12 to 5 for **Star Dance** relic of the Astromancer
  [*]Nerf late meter to travel of [b]Starry Trail[/b] relic but improve early from 10/9/8/7/5m to 8.5/8/7.5/7/6m
[/list]

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]

[list]
  [*]Add to the description of [b]Energy Attacker[/b] relic that the number of shoot depends on the attack speed
  [*]Stop time when changing weapon
  [*]Improve event system
  [*]Added slash animation for every hit down with [b]Shadow Sneak[/b] active ability of the Samuraï
  [*][b]Thunder Incarnation[/b] boss now stop their thunder while dying
  [*]Reduce particles when shooting by 50%
  [*]Reduce A LOT the lags due to lights
[/list]

[h2]Fixs[/h2]

[list]
  [*]The color hearts (thundering and thorny) were disabling their immunity upon any damage for the room
  [*][b]Rubber[/b] relic was still given shields
  [*][b]Growing Projectile[/b] only gave bonus to the first projectile hit per unique enemies instead of all projectile, added a limit of 10 times
  [*]Projectiles that have bouncing and pass through walls will now not bounce
  [*][b]Pink Blossom Katana[/b] was creating too much petals
  [*]Final damages were very wrongly calculated, making absurd amount of damage with only some bonus
[/list]

notes.title: v0.4.1 - Refactors & Improvements
notes.content:
Last time I said I will start adding more relics and stuff, but I needed to make some improvements first, so this is for the next update instead.

[h1]v0.4.1 - Refactors & Improvements[/h1]

[h2]Major changes[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Change all keyboard/mouse icons to my own in pixel art
[/list]

[h3]Astro refactor[/h3]

I was not satisfied with the kit of the astro, it was weird, so I make some changes.
First passive:[list]
    [*]Remove the homing chance
    [*]Instead of spawning star on the player, spawn them on the nearest enemy
[/list]

The second passive has completly changed:[list]
    [*]When a star hit an enemy, it has a 5/7/9/11/15% chance to spawn a [b]Star Fragment[/b], that will be collected by the player
    [*]For each [b]Star Fragment[/b], it increase by 0.5% the speed, by 2% the damage of stars and has a chance to spawn stars when hitting enemies
    [*]Lost 85/80/75/70/50% of the [b]Star Fragment[/b] when leaving a fortress
[/list]

[h3]Samuraï refactor[/h3]

I made his active ability do a fast dash to the mouse position, hitting any crossed enemies using the main weapon and decreasing the cooldown by 5% per hits
And I changed the second passive to shoot around the player at the end of a dash

[h3]Trails[/h3]

Make trails independent from projectile and can be applied everywhere.
They didn't disappear instantly when a projectile hit and stay until all the trace is finished.
All trails have been improved to look better, like the one for the [b]Soul Sword projectile[/b].

[h3]Color Aura and the impact of color[/h3]

Make each fortress be able to force their color into all objects, the impact is reduced every floor clear.
The color aura around the player restitute the original color of all objects around him, repelling the fortress color.
The color catalyser now really absorb the color of the room and need to have color in the room to be activated

[h3]Refactor color hearts[/h3]

I added the Thundering Heart and remake the Thorny Heart to give unique bonus and consume ability
Thundering Heart make you immune to thunder and give a buff when you touch one, gain a passive 30% speed
Thorny Heart make you immune to poison pools (will be in future green color) and give a buff when you touch one, gain a passive 30% refire

[h2]Modifiers[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Added [b]Elite Apocalypse[/b]: spawn all the color elite in the room but increase a lot the loot
    [*]Added [b]Gold Hour[/b]: killed enemies drop a coin (90%) or a tiny bag of 5 golds (10%)
    [*]Added [b]King Legacy[/b]: a really rare modifier that give a lot of good stuff
    [*]Added [b]Sacrificial Altar[/b]: you can sacrifice your hearts to gain rare items
[/list]

[h2]Relics[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Removing [b]Emotional Outburst[/b]
    [*]Added [b]Outburst[/b]: Increase by 15/25/40% Aoe Damage and by 5/10/20% Aoe Critical Chance
    [*]Added [b]Overgrown[/b]: Increase by 15/25/40% Aoe Range and by 5/8/15% Aoe Refire
[/list]

[h2]Weapons[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Bring back the legendary [b]Volcano Staff[/b], it's not using a ray anymore but launch fire balls from the sky
    [*]Refactor the epic [b]Pink Blossom Katana[/b], it launch a lot more petals and the damage have been divided by 2
[/list]

[h2]Collectibles[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Added [b]Free Ticket[/b]: Make a shop item free
    [*]Added [b]Discount[/b]: Apply a discount on all shop items
    [*]Added [b]Duplicator[/b]: Duplicate all items on the ground, including weapons
    [*]Added [b]Fortune[/b]: Double all your golds
[/list]

[h2]Stats[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Added [b]Aoe Critical Chance[/b]
    [*]Added [b]Aoe Refire[/b]: chance to trigger again the aoe
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Improve prediction of the player for enemies
    [*]Increase yellow color infused level 4 from 30% to 50% bonus in thunder damage & radius
    [*]Reduce base Critical Damage from 100% to 50%
    [*]Increase base Critical Chance from 3% to 5%
[/list]

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Improve looks of chests
    [*]Change icon of merchant
    [*]Adjust text placement of modifiers on doors
    [*]Change the weight of items in shop and treasure chests
    [*]Display more unique colors when ability is recovering, ready or in use
    [*]Lock mouse into the game
[/list]

[h2]Fixs[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Fix the position of boss rewards
    [*][b]Qi Sword weapon[/b] use the wrong number of projectile (2 instead of 1)
    [*]Projectile that create an aoe on hit were applying stat boosting twice
    [*]Fix how color infused work, a mess
    [*]Fix bouncing comportment (often blocked in walls)
    [*]In some case, the items spawn by treasure chest was blocking the opening of doors
    [*]Bonus crates were not dropping an item with 100% chance sometimes
    [*]1st passive of Pyromancer was not applying burn with ray weapons
    [*]Souls swords were not spawning on the start room for Soul Reaper character
    [*]Him class was making the game crash when you have only 2 characters unlocked
[/list]

notes.title: v0.4.0 - Merchant & Room Modifiers
notes.content:
[h1]v0.4.0[/h1]

[h2]Major changes[/h2]

[h3]Merchant[/h3]

[list]
    [*]Work like the elite room, it can spawn in any room (except start and boss), available at the top of the room when it's clear
    [*]Give 5 items to buy
    [*]You can reroll the items (price increase each time) and start price scale with fortress number
    [*]The shop keeper sell sometimes an exotic item, that would be only available in other fortress normally
[/list]

[h3]Room Modifier System[/h3]

This is a system that add content to a room without changing the reward, it can increase it or make the enemies stronger[list]
    [*]Modifiers that increase the loot have a chest icon
    [*]Modifers that increase the difficulty have a death skull
[/list]

[h3]Snowman Refactor[/h3]

I changed his ability from:[list]
    [*]A big snowball send in the direction of mouse, creating a giant frost explosion on hit
To:
    [*]Make frost shard fall around the mouse for 3s (can be increase by various stats), creating a lot of small frost explosions
    [*]Rely more on frost burn effect than pure damage
[/list]

I also changed his second passive to make him less op, I removed his ability to gain permanent aoe range and damage, instead I increase a bit his damage from:[list]
    [*]... ice spikes deals 5/8/11/14/20 damages
To:
    [*]... ice spikes deals 10/13/16/19/25 damages
[/list]

[h3]Samuraï Refactor[/h3]

I changed the side effect of the active ability from boosting stats to:[list]
    [*]Shoot around the player, the number of shots depends on the APS
[/list]

I also changed his second passive from gaining various stats to:[list]
    [*]On dash, the next 3/4/5/6/7 shots will do a critical hit
[/list]

Later, I will remake his ability like I want

[h2]Modifiers added[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Merchant
    [*]Weapon Merchant
    [*]Curse: Spawn thunder on the player regularly (has 3 modes)
    [*]Horde: Double the normal enemies and change them to a single type
    [*]Treasure: Spawn 1 to 3 chest with a rare item inside, can be increase by going against strong enemies
[/list]

[h2]Collectibles added[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Relic Upgrader: Upgrade a relic you own
    [*]Weapon Upgrader: Increase the level of the weapon by 1/3/5/7/10, depend on the rarity
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Increase [b]relic of yellow altar tier 2[/b], gain 3 -> 5 golds on room clear
    [*]Increase damage of [b]Katana weapon[/b] from 20-40 to 30-50
    [*]Increase [b]Soul Sword[/b] speed by 50%
    [*]Decrease bonus projectile size and speed from [b]Soul Cycle (2nd passive of Soul Reaper)[/b] from 150% to 75%
    [*]Nerf [b]thunder[/b] damage from 100 to 75
    [*][b]Heart Drinker relic[/b] will now only drop half red heart and half shield
    [*][b]Unstable Projectile[/b] relic now apply things like homing from the original projectile
    [*]Decrease APS of [b]Shadow Scythe weapon[/b] from 1.5 to 1
    [*]Increase chance of applying shadow curse for [b]Shadow Scythe weapon[/b] from 15% to 30%
    [*]Buff [b]Charged Ability yellow relic[/b] from thunder targeting near enemies to thunder falling upon all enemies
    [*]Buff [b]Repeater relic[/b] from 5/15/30% to 10/20/35% chance of refire
    [*]Decrease damage of [b]Shell Staff weapon[/b] from 75-100 to 40-60 and reduce APS from 3 to 2
    [*]Decrease damage of [b]Cosmic Ray weapon[/b] from 200-250 to 100-130
[/list]

[h3]Double shots relic[/h3]

[list]
    [*]Add a 20/50/80% chance to make the shot critical when refiring
    [*]Decrease chance to refire from 15/35/70% to 10/25/40%
[/list][h3]Qi Sword weapon[/h3]

[list]
    [*]Decrease damage from 110-140 to 55-75
    [*]Increase damage by 10% per meter without hit any enemies
    [*]Increase projectile speed by 20% per unique enemies hit
    [*]Decrease projectile lifetime from 30s to 10s
    [*]Decrease projectile speed from 20 to 15
    [*]Allow additional projectiles from refire or projectile stat
[/list]

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Change gold reward to give a lot of different coins
    [*]Change how gold gain work to still gain bonus gold with amounts like 1 gold
    [*]Add current version number to main menu
    [*]Make color flask usable in fight and freeze the time
    [*]Weapons found will be first the one player haven't discovered yet
    [*]Redesign some old projectiles
    [*]Remove lights from some projectiles (will reduce lags)
    [*]Enemy taken by Absolute Control ability can now take damage from player
    [*]New icon
    [*]Added the future skill tree in the hub (only visual for now)
    [*]Changed how projectile speed work (so souls sword and some other projs are fixed now)
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixs[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Stat displayed on the left were displaying a change even with a 0% difference
    [*]Execution bar was displayed on allies
    [*]Relics displayed by relic selector were not centered on screens other than 16:9
    [*]Fix the third level yellow color when infused in a weapon
    [*]Rays were not given stats correctly
[/list]

[h1]Next[/h1]

[h2]Major things[/h2]

Add a system of "tag" for relics, weapons and active abilities, in order to only show relics that can be use by your current build.
Then, add A LOT of new relics, like I have listed more than 130 relics, I want to add a lot of them.
And, if I have time, some new weapons as well as the refactor of bounce and pierce.[h2]Minor things[/h2]

I'm planning to add more collectible (I was a bit late for this update) and some other room modifiers.
Also, refactor the samuraï like I wanted (but it takes some time to do it properly)

notes.title: Demo release and v0.3.1
notes.content:
[h1]v0.3.1[/h1]

[h2]Major changes[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Added credits to main menu
    [*]Buff Soul Reaper class by various ways
    [*]Change Blue Heart to Shield (more logic)
    [*]Add stat Execution Rate and display rate on enemy life bar (Divided by 4 for bosses)
    [*]Add Shadow Curse effect (give 2.5% execution rate per stack, max 10 stacks), applied by Shadow Scythe
    [*]Change the whole ui windows to something more clear, rp and cool
[/list]

[h2]Balancing[/h2]
[h3]Soul Reaper Class[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Increase health by one shield
[/list][h3]Small Scythe Weapon:[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Make projectile increase his size and damage over time
    [*]Become 1 hand instead of 2 hands
[/list][h3]Soul Cycle Relic (2nd passive of Soul Reaper)[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Increase with Projectile Range stat the radius within you have to be from enemies to gain bonus
[/list]
[h3]A Better World Relic (2nd passive of Pyromancer)[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Change effect from: Give global total damage every time an enemy is burnt
    [*]To: Increase damage dealt to enemies for every stack of burn they have
[/list]
[h3]Executioner[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Remove health drop
    [*]Increase executioner rate from 10/12/15% to 10/16/30%
[/list][h3]Shadow Scythe[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Decrease damage from 75-90 to 50-65
    [*]Decrease APS from 2 to 1.5
    [*]Add 15% chance to apply Shadow Curse for 3s
[/list][h3]Frost Burn effect[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Change damage formula from: 15 damage per stacks every 0.25s (too op)
    [*]To: Exponential damage over time per stack -> (1 + Total duration / 2) x Stacks and add a -5% speed per stacks
[/list]

[h2]Loot from decoration[/h2]
[h3]Pots[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Increase chance to get 1 coin from 1% to 2%
    [*]Add a 1% chance to get an half shield
[/list]
[h3]Regular boxes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Increase chance to get a rune from 1% to 2%
    [*]Add a 3% chance to get an half shield
[/list]
[h3]Bonus boxes[/h3]
[list]
    [*]Reduce chance to get a rune from 80% to 60%
    [*]Add a 20% chance to get a full shield
[/list]

[h2]Quality of life[/h2]
[list]
    [*]Replace fx particle used by weapons found by the new Sparkle
    [*]Explosion from Detonation active ability of Pyromancer now appear faster at a fixed time
    [*]Change icon of available hand to nothing
    [*]Add background to stat display on left when increasing a stat to see it more clearly
    [*]Indicate in the class when it cannot gain red heart
    [*]Add more parts to monster corpse
    [*]Add corpse for new monster (forget to add)
    [*]Improve design of Spiky Scepter and change his name to match the new projectile
[/list]

[h2]Bug fix[/h2]

[list]
    [*]At high APS, weapons were not shooting at correct speed
    [*]Remove pickup text on empty weapon slot
    [*]Prevent dashing when inside a menu
    [*]Enemy projectiles are now correctly stopped by flambo
[/list]

[h2]Other[/h2]

[list]
    [*]Renamed [b]Special Ability[/b] to [b]Active Ability[/b]
    [*]Renamed [b]Dash[/b] in french to [b]Ruée[/b]
    [*]Remove X icon in change weapon menu
[/list]
